# simplevm_flavor (Data Source)

Looks up a VM flavor (size) by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplevm_flavor" "small" {
  name = "de.NBI small"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact flavor name, for example `de.NBI small`.

### Optional

- `project_id` (Number) SimpleVM project ID. Defaults to the provider `project_id`; the effective value is exported.

### Read-Only

- `credits_cost_per_hour` (Number) Credits consumed per hour.
- `ephemeral_disk` (Number) Ephemeral disk size in GB.
- `gpu` (Number) Number of GPUs.
- `id` (String) Identifier, `<project_id>/<name>`.
- `ram` (Number) RAM in MB.
- `root_disk` (Number) Root disk size in GB.
- `vcpus` (Number) Number of virtual CPUs.
